report.status_line: Water trailer tank ruptured delaying resupply; ~360 L water remaining; propane at 40%.

concerns.title: Trailer tank rupture delays water resupply
concerns.detail: At 12:35pm, the crew received notice that the trailer tank broke en route and ruptured, delaying resupply. Current water is estimated at ~360 L (static level 15 cm). For the crew of 7 with 10 days remaining until mission end on 2015-01-23, this volume will last about 4.2 days at the FMARS rate (12.12 L/person/day) or about 20.6 days at the NASA potable minimum (2.5 L/person/day).

concerns.title: Propane running low before mission end
concerns.detail: Propane is at 40%, dropping at a rate of -5% per day from 45% on 2015-01-12. At this rate, propane is projected to run out in about 8 days, before the mission ends in 10 days on 2015-01-23.

concerns.title: Mobility issues with ATV 3 and ATV 5
concerns.detail: ATV 3 powered on but shut down after 20 seconds. ATV 5 failed to start completely. These malfunctions limit crew mobility.

concerns.title: Hot water unavailable
concerns.detail: The crew reported that hot water has still not been attained in the habitat.

crew_actions: Implement strict water rationing protocols to conserve the remaining ~360 L of water.
Perform basic diagnostics and inspect battery/fuel connections on ATV 3 and ATV 5.
Monitor propane consumption daily and reduce non-essential heating usage.
Check hot water plumbing and heating elements for faults.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Arrange replacement trailer tank and schedule emergency water resupply.
decisions_for_earth.why: The trailer tank ruptured en route, leaving the crew with ~360 L of water which lasts only about 4.2 days at standard analog usage rates.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Provide contingency procedures for water shortages and clarify water tank references.
decisions_for_earth.why: The crew requested procedures for managing water shortages and clarification on which tank was referenced in Mission Support communications.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Review and approve the requested EVA for Jan 14th 2015.
decisions_for_earth.why: The commander submitted an official request for EVA approval for Jan 14th 2015.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Approve proposed modification to tie-down setup using an extra mattress cover.
decisions_for_earth.why: The crew requested approval to modify the setup to make securing ties manageable while wearing EVA gloves.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Provide propane resupply or usage reduction guidance.
decisions_for_earth.why: Propane is at 40% and projected to empty in about 8 days, prior to the end of the mission in 10 days.

report.message_to_earth: Overall status is critical due to a ruptured water resupply trailer tank. At 12:35pm, the trailer tank broke en route and ruptured, delaying resupply and leaving ~360 L of water, which will last about 4.2 days for the 7 crew members. The crew is conserving water and inspecting equipment. Propane is at 40% with ~8 days remaining, diesel is nominal at 75%, hot water is unavailable, and ATV 3 and ATV 5 failed. We request dispatch of a replacement water trailer and water shortage procedures before tomorrow. Next update will be sent tomorrow.
